主要内容: Coty Inc. filed a report on May 11, 2020, under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The report was signed by Pierre-André Terisse, the Chief Financial Officer of Coty Inc. The filing includes a press release regarding the company's financial results dated May 11, 2020. The report is accompanied by an Interactive Data File embedded within the Inline XBRL document. This filing indicates that Coty Inc. is providing updated financial information to its stakeholders.
